summary:
Our Mission: Helping Astronauts Survive and Thrive on Mars
At ASTERONIX, our mission is to help astronauts survive, adapt, and thrive in the extreme and challenging environment of Mars.
To address the challenges of living on the Red Planet, we have designed and developed 7 innovative tools and simulators to support future Mars missions.
These technologies aim to help astronauts analyze environmental conditions, manage essential resources, identify potential hazards, and make smarter, safer decisions.
Our Vision: Combining science, technology, and creativity to build a safer future for humanity on Mars.
details:
What it does. ASTERONIX is our HTML-based web app with 7 tools and simulators that help astronauts survive and thrive on Mars. Users can analyse environmental conditions, manage essential resources such as water, food, oxygen and energy, identify hazards, and test decisions in simulated mission scenarios.

Benefits and impact. It brings the main survival questions of a Mars mission into one place, helping astronauts and mission planners make smarter, safer decisions, and helping students and the public understand life on the Red Planet.

Tools. HTML, CSS and JavaScript in a single web file that runs in any browser. No installation, server or special hardware is needed.

Creativity. It combines science, technology and creativity: instead of one calculator, seven connected tools turn Mars data into interactive, hands-on decisions.

Factors considered. Astronaut safety, the scarcity of resources on Mars, extreme environmental conditions, and keeping the tools easy to use and scientifically grounded.
